evidence_basis: Dirkx et al. 2026 Brain (PMID 42249507, DOI 10.1093/brain/awag199), accepted manuscript PDF on this host (37 pages, 2,626,225 bytes, SHA-256 e7206f1d2882b7a1b987f29975177b6e36a0fbf2d599835a375ff7ddc654c2b7, verified): abstract, introduction, the main-text Methods, all Results sections, the Discussion and the figure legends read; page images of Fig. 1 (single-cell electrophysiology and M-current) and Fig. 4 (retigabine in KCNQ2-G290D iNeurons) viewed; the other figures are captions only. Supplementary materials (Supplementary Figs 1 to 16, Tables 1 to 9, including Supplementary Fig. 13) not read: the publisher page returned a challenge page (HTTP 403) on one plain request and the repository record carries no supplement; no further route tried. No source data exist (data on reasonable request); no number recomputed.
